notes: The same fixed interrogative 'ey-zeh was split here too, with the demonstrative left unrepresented. The ASV writes the single determiner what for the pair, so the two morphemes share one unit under rule 30, headed on 'ey, exactly as the corpus fuses the same compound to what at 1KI.13.12 and ISA.66.1 and to which at ECC.11.6.
